identity.title: [v0.92.1][Runtime][bug] Make A2A action selection reliable for model-backed agents

values.goal: Make model-backed A2A initiation a reliable first-class Runtime action rather than an exact-JSON roleplay convention.
values.required_outcome: Production conversation ingress selects a typed bounded A2A action from ordinary model-style provider output, the Runtime validates and dispatches it through existing authority, the recipient executes, and correlated activity is observable.
declared_scope: Runtime provider conversation prompt and output boundary
authority_boundary: Runtime constructs and validates initiation authority
Preserve Layer8 admission eligibility replay cancellation and correlation semantics
No cloud or paid provider execution
operator_constraints: Test until production-ingress behavior works reliably
